pages.title: Silver
pages.text:
A precious metal for fighting the undead.

- **Tier:** Iron
- **Durability:** 280
- **Sword damage:** 6
- **Armor (full set):** 15

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text: **Silver Ore** is found between Y -16 and Y 48, in stone and deepslate. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better, then smelt or blast the raw silver.

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text:
- **Hallowed:** silver swords, spears, and axes deal 4 extra damage to undead (zombies, skeletons, phantoms, the wither, and so on). It stacks with Smite.
- **Warding:** each armor piece takes 6%% less damage from undead, including arrows from skeletons (24%% for the full set).
- **Shield:** blocking an undead mob knocks it back hard.

pages.title: Blessed
pages.text: **Full set bonus.** Wither lasts half as long, and undead within 8 blocks glow, so you can see them through walls.
A blast furnace works too, and is faster.
